full_judgment: 3. Thereafter, the petitioner No. 1 filed a suit in the 1st Court of Sub-Judge Dhaka, being Title Suit No. 180 of 1972 for a decree for declaration of Title for the suit property on compromise on terms of the solenama filed in Court by the petitioner No. 1 and, the original allottee, which was decreed in terms of the petition of compromise declaring the right, title and interest of the petitioner No.1 in the suit property. Although the decree was filed to the office of the respondent No. 3 for mutation of the name of the petitioner No. 1 which was not allowed on a technical ground that the decree was not binding on the government as it was not made a party in the suit. The decree in favour of the petitioner No. 1 is annexed as Annexure A to the writ petition.
